header.cleanBody:
This card can't be used on Your Turn, and is banished from the game after its effect resolves.

When the number of cards in your deck becomes zero due to the opponent, you can immediately use the following effect.

█ Return all your banished cards and cards in your Trash to the deck and shuffle it. Then, during this turn, increase the LV cost of every opposing Spirit/Ultimate/Nexus by +2.
